original_value: This fictional article examines the design of foldable pedestrian bridges built for temporary night markets and traveling fairs. It combines architectural sketching, lightweight timber joinery, and lantern-guided wayfinding to propose a modular bridge system that can be assembled without heavy machinery. The work focuses on aesthetic portability, reversible construction, and civic storytelling rather than automation, robotics, or signal processing.
